# Priyanshu Chauhan

> Priyanshu Chauhan is the founder of Beyond Bound, a Mumbai-based wellness brand focused on healthy weight management. He is an MBA from K J Somaiya Institute of Management, with a background across agriculture, product strategy, and new product development.

## About

Priyanshu Chauhan (Founder & Director, Beyond Bound) builds consumer wellness products in India with clear, responsible product information. Beyond Bound's first product, Glycomics, is a weight management formula designed to support healthy weight management as part of a balanced lifestyle. The brand is operated by AyurHelix Pvt Ltd and sells on beyondbound.co and Amazon.in.

## Roles and background

- Founder & Director, Beyond Bound (AyurHelix Pvt Ltd), Mumbai, India
- MBA, K J Somaiya Institute of Management
- Background in agriculture, product strategy, and new product development (NPD)
